title: 鐵路車站排煙整合~Railway-station smoke-control integration
focus: 車站煙流風路與疏散需求的整合~Integrating station smoke paths airflow and egress requirements
summary: 本課聚焦車站煙流風路與疏散需求的整合。從排煙斷面速度分布建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把風速量級與壓力與控制與照明備援連成可驗證的介面，最後以排煙模式整合案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies integrating station smoke paths airflow and egress requirements. Start with velocity distribution in exhaust sections to define physical or information boundaries, connect air-speed scale and pressure with backup for controls and lighting as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through integrated smoke-mode cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1991 年一九八五年緊急整備指南於該年重印。；2015 年地下車站旅客流研究報告於該年出版。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對車站煙流風路與疏散需求的整合而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用風機壓升能量帳及共用風路失效原因連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1991: The rail-transit emergency guide originally published in nineteen eighty-five was reprinted. 2015: A study of underground-station passenger flow was published. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For integrating station smoke paths airflow and egress requirements, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through fan pressure and energy accounting and fault causes in shared airflow paths. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究排煙斷面速度分布。原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。敏感度只改 A=16 至 17.6 m2，輸出變為 1.81818 m/s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究風機壓升能量帳：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate velocity distribution in exhaust sections. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. For sensitivity, change only A=16 to 17.6 m2; the output becomes 1.81818 m/s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate fan pressure and energy accounting: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 排煙斷面速度分布~Velocity distribution in exhaust sections
units.title: 排煙斷面速度分布~Velocity distribution in exhaust sections
units.mechanism: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。風向與煙氣來源位置同樣重要；正常通風的舒適性目標和火災時的煙流控制目標不能共用一個數字就視為完成驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。~Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean. Direction and smoke-source location also matter. Normal comfort ventilation and emergency smoke control cannot be validated by one shared number alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved.
units.verify: 在斷面多點量測速度與方向，積分得到流量，再檢查門開閉或列車位置變化。以「排煙斷面速度分布」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure velocity and direction at several section points, integrate flow, and repeat for changed door or train positions. For velocity distribution in exhaust sections, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 單點風速可剛好量到高速射流而高估全斷面流量，反向區域也可能被平均抵消。回到「排煙斷面速度分布」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~One sensor may sample a fast jet and overstate total flow; reverse-flow regions can disappear in an unsigned average. Trace the input chain for velocity distribution in exhaust sections. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求~One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements.
units.practice: 只把有效通風面積 A 從 16 改成 17.6 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 m/s。先說明「排煙斷面速度分布」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only effective airflow area A from 16 to 17.6 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for velocity distribution in exhaust sections, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 風機壓升能量帳~Fan pressure and energy accounting
units.title: 風機壓升能量帳~Fan pressure and energy accounting
units.mechanism: 本單元將風機壓升、風道損失與輸入功率放在同一工作點，檢查備援設備是否共用阻塞路徑。風機輸入功率由流量乘壓升再除效率估算。壓力不足與流路阻力增加都會改變工作點，不能把銘牌額定流量視為任何風道中都能達成；備援風機還可能共享同一阻塞路徑而無法提供預想的獨立能力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。~Place fan pressure rise, duct loss and input power at one operating point, checking whether redundant equipment shares a blocked path. Fan input power is flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency. Inadequate pressure and increased duct resistance shift the operating point; nameplate flow is not guaranteed in every duct. Redundant fans may also share a blocked path and fail to provide the expected independent capability. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change.
units.verify: 同時量測流量、前後壓差與電功率，對照風門位置並檢查各項能量是否一致。以「風機壓升能量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure flow, pressure rise and electrical power together, correlate with damper position, and check energy consistency. For fan pressure and energy accounting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 風門位置回授正常但機械連桿脫落會形成錯誤狀態，僅看馬達運轉訊號無法證明有足夠送風。回到「風機壓升能量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A detached damper linkage can coexist with apparently normal position feedback; a motor-running signal does not prove adequate airflow. Trace the input chain for fan pressure and energy accounting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成~A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
units.practice: 只把總壓升 dp 從 600 改成 660 Pa（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 34.2857 變為 37.7143 kW。先說明「風機壓升能量帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only total pressure rise dp from 600 to 660 Pa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 34.2857 to 37.7143 kW. Explain the causal direction for fan pressure and energy accounting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 門口與旁通流量~Doorway and bypass flow
units.title: 門口與旁通流量~Doorway and bypass flow
units.mechanism: 本單元以孔口近似比較門開度與壓差，明示此模型無法解析上下反向的分層煙流。開口通風量由壓差驅動，受面積與縮流損失共同控制。流量和壓差平方根成正比，不是線性比例；旁通開口增加可能減輕壓力卻同時改變煙氣路徑，因此開口位置和通風模式必須一起討論。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。~Compare door opening and pressure difference with an orifice approximation, explicitly excluding counterflowing stratified smoke from the model. Pressure difference drives opening flow, with area and contraction losses jointly controlling it. Flow scales with the square root of pressure rather than linearly. Adding a bypass can relieve pressure while changing smoke paths, so location and ventilation mode must be considered together. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：流量係數 Cd=0.65 1；開口面積 A=4 m2；兩側壓差 dp=80 Pa；空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3。公式 y=Cd*A*sqrt(2*dp/rho)，代入得 y=30.0222 m3/s。邊界：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: discharge coefficient Cd=0.65 1; opening area A=4 m2; pressure difference dp=80 Pa; air density rho=1.2 kg/m3. Formula y=Cd*A*sqrt(2*dp/rho) gives y=30.0222 m3/s. Boundary: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded.
units.verify: 量測開口兩側壓差與斷面流量，將不同開度下的結果畫成流量對壓差平方根。以「門口與旁通流量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure pressure difference and section flow, then plot flow against square-root pressure for several openings. For doorway and bypass flow, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 格柵堵塞會改變有效面積與損失係數，僅看風門命令開度可能誤判實際旁通能力。回到「門口與旁通流量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Blocked grilles alter effective area and loss coefficient; commanded damper opening can misrepresent actual bypass capacity. Trace the input chain for doorway and bypass flow. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 開口壓差增加四倍時流量一定增加四倍~Quadrupling pressure difference necessarily quadruples opening flow.
units.practice: 只把兩側壓差 dp 從 80 改成 88 Pa（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.0222 變為 31.4876 m3/s。先說明「門口與旁通流量」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only pressure difference dp from 80 to 88 Pa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.0222 to 31.4876 m3/s. Explain the causal direction for doorway and bypass flow, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 風速量級與壓力~Air-speed scale and pressure
units.title: 風速量級與壓力~Air-speed scale and pressure
units.mechanism: 本單元把動壓作為局部量級參考，另量門兩側靜壓以避免將迎風測壓值直接當作門負荷。動壓與風速平方成正比，這有助判斷列車活塞作用與門扇負載的量級。實際瞬變壓力仍受隧道阻塞率、旁通開口與波傳反射影響；動壓不是任何測點必定出現的靜壓差，兩者不能直接等同。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。~Use dynamic pressure as a local scale reference and separately measure static pressure on both sides of a door instead of equating an impact reading with door load. Dynamic pressure scales with speed squared, helping estimate the magnitude of train-induced airflow and door loading. Actual transients also depend on blockage, bypass openings and wave reflections. Dynamic pressure is not automatically the static pressure difference measured at a particular location. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=0.5*rho*v*v gives y=135 Pa. Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution.
units.verify: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。以「風速量級與壓力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign. For air-speed scale and pressure, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。回到「風速量級與壓力」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. Trace the input chain for air-speed scale and pressure. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍~Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure.
units.practice: 只把代表風速 v 從 15 改成 16.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 135 變為 163.35 Pa。先說明「風速量級與壓力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only representative air speed v from 15 to 16.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 135 to 163.35 Pa. Explain the causal direction for air-speed scale and pressure, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 煙流與清空時間邊界~Smoke and clearance-time boundaries
units.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界~Smoke and clearance-time boundaries
units.mechanism: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。~Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service. This serial estimate conservatively adds travel and queuing, which can overlap in reality. Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.
units.verify: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「煙流與清空時間邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For smoke and clearance-time boundaries, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

units.anchor: 偵測至風路建立~From detection to established airflow
units.title: 偵測至風路建立~From detection to established airflow
units.mechanism: 本單元記錄偵測、模式判定、風門動作與氣流建立，避免以電氣啟動回授代替真正風路形成。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Record detection, mode decision, damper travel and airflow establishment, avoiding substitution of electrical start feedback for an established flow path. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.

units.anchor: 控制與照明備援~Backup for controls and lighting
units.title: 控制與照明備援~Backup for controls and lighting
units.mechanism: 本單元把控制器與指示照明負載獨立列帳，明示小型電池算例不代表整組排煙風機的供電。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。~Account separately for controls and directional lighting, explicitly noting that this small-battery example does not represent power for the complete smoke-exhaust fan set. Battery duration divides usable energy by load, so ampere-hours alone are insufficient without voltage. Temperature, ageing, discharge rate and cutoff affect usable fraction. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.

units.anchor: 低照度疏散辨識~Egress recognition under low lighting
units.title: 低照度疏散辨識~Egress recognition under low lighting
units.mechanism: 本單元先量無煙環境照度與暗點，再列出煙氣散射尚未涵蓋，避免把照度合格當作能見度合格。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。~Measure smoke-free illuminance and dark areas first, then list unmodelled smoke scattering rather than treating adequate illuminance as adequate visibility. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.

units.anchor: 共用風路失效原因~Fault causes in shared airflow paths
units.title: 共用風路失效原因~Fault causes in shared airflow paths
units.mechanism: 本單元把供電、風門卡滯與流路阻塞分開建樹，要求各原因有不同量測證據而非只看運轉訊號。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。~Separate supply loss, stuck dampers and path blockage in a cause tree, requiring distinct evidence rather than one common running signal. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.

units.anchor: 排煙模式整合案例~Integrated smoke-mode cases
units.title: 排煙模式整合案例~Integrated smoke-mode cases
units.mechanism: 本單元在離線模型組合列車位置、門狀態與單設備故障，將未測邊界逐一連到設計需求。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Combine train location, door state and single-equipment faults in an offline model, tracing untested boundaries to design requirements. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
